english.title: Fish for / takes salmon in waters in the Tweed district without lawful or written authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fished for or took salmon in waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY WATERS LOCATION..), without legal right or written permission from a person having such right
english.legislation: Contrary to article 27(1) of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: The offence includes waters being any part of the sea within 1.5 kilometres of mean low water springs.
